title: Position: Theory of Mind Benchmarks are Broken for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM functional and literal Theory of Mind performance in repeated matrix games by comparing results when using canonical action names (e.g., 'Rock', 'Paper', 'Scissors') versus neutral token representations (e.g., 'J', 'F', 'B') to measure the impact of prior semantic knowledge on adaptation.
